brief:
An Israeli attack on a Doctors Without Borders clinic in Gaza resulted in a direct hit that killed two staff members, the organization said. MSF called the strike a violation of international humanitarian law and demanded accountability from those responsible for the operation.

The strike represents the latest civilian casualty incident amid ongoing Israeli military operations in Gaza. Doctors Without Borders, also known as MSF, has previously documented damage to health facilities in the territory during the conflict.
dek: MSF says premises 'clearly marked' with its logos, location communicated to and known by Israeli military.
title: Israeli strike kills two Doctors Without Borders staff in Gaza
